Prime Minister Anthony Albanese renewed calls for the audio to be released in parliamentary Question Time on Thursday, saying it's part of the transparency Australia has called for "from day one".

Israeli ambassador to Australia Hillel Newman on Friday told ABC radio the audio may contain "intelligence information" and there was nothing in it to cast doubt on the findings which cleared the IDF of criminal misconduct.

In a statement on Thursday, Frankcom's family called on the government to continue pressing Israel to release the audio and to "pursue all available legal avenues for an independent and credible investigation to be conducted".

However Dr Emily Crawford, an international law professor at the University of Sydney, said Australia's options were limited.

"In all states, the scope to argue that national security grounds required for information not to be released, they're fairly paramount," she told SBS News.

"We've seen that the Netanyahu government is reluctant to assist in these kinds of things, so I can't imagine there's really going to be any movement on that."

The missing audio is just one of the unanswered questions surrounding the strike, with Wong saying the IDF had failed to explain how two strikes occurred after the initial strike, in breach of the IDF's rules of engagement.

She said questions also remained about why the strike occurred in a humanitarian fire control zone, and about the role of a senior brigade...
body.zh: 被杀的澳大利亚援助人员佐米·弗兰克科姆的家人表示，他们将继续争取正义，无人机音频丢失仍然是有关她死亡的核心悬而未决的问题之一。 以色列本周宣布，不会起诉 2024 年 4 月在加沙杀害 Frankcom 及其六名世界中央厨房同事的责任人，尽管承认导致以色列国防军 (IDF) 无人机袭击的“严重失误”。 周四，外交部长黄英贤表示，这一决定“令人愤慨”，“鉴于许多悬而未决的问题”，她对以色列国防军军法署署长为期两年的调查没有信心。 未解决的问题之一是无人机录像音频的缺失，尽管联邦政府提出要求，但以色列拒绝将其交给由退休空军上将马克·宾斯金领导的澳大利亚独立调查机构。 根据他的报告，宾斯金获得了 90 分钟未经编辑的无人机镜头，但其中不包括音轨。该报告发现，杀戮是由于身份错误和程序失误造成的，而不是故意针对援助人员。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯再次呼吁在周四的议会质询时间公布该音频，称这是澳大利亚“从第一天起”所呼吁的透明度的一部分。 以色列驻澳大利亚大使希勒尔·纽曼周五告诉美国广播公司广播电台，该音频可能包含“情报信息”，其中没有任何内容可以对澄清以色列国防军犯罪不当行为的调查结果产生怀疑。 在周四的一份声明中，弗兰克科姆的家人呼吁政府继续敦促以色列公布音频，并“寻求一切可用的法律途径进行独立和可信的调查”。 然而，悉尼大学国际法教授艾米丽·克劳福德博士表示，澳大利亚的选择有限。 她告诉 SBS 新闻：“在所有州，以国家安全为由要求不公开信息的范围是相当重要的。” “我们已经看到内塔尼亚胡政府不愿意在此类事情上提供协助，所以我无法想象这方面真的会有任何进展。” 失踪的音频只是有关这次袭击的未解答的问题之一，黄表示，以色列国防军未能解释第一次袭击后如何发生两次袭击，这违反了以色列国防军的交战规则。 她说，关于为什么袭击发生在人道主义火力控制区以及高级旅的作用的问题仍然存在......

reflection.en: When an investigation concludes without fully resolving critical questions, it can feel as though justice itself is paralyzed. This ongoing pursuit of truth reflects a deep human longing for accountability and clarity in the face of tragedy. Yahweh's heart is for justice to flow freely, especially when the systems designed to deliver it seem to falter.
reflection.zh: 当一项调查在未能完全解决关键问题的情况下结束时，会让人感觉正义本身陷入了停滞。这种对真相的持续追究，反映了人类在悲剧面前对问责和澄清的深切渴望。雅伟的心意是让公义自由流淌，尤其当旨在伸张正义的系统似乎失效时。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: What Europe's shrinking rivers reveal, and why Australia should take notice
title.zh: 欧洲河流萎缩揭示了什么，以及澳大利亚为何应引起关注

summary.en: Discoveries from Europe's shrinking rivers highlight environmental challenges that extend globally, prompting other regions like Australia to observe and learn.
summary.zh: 欧洲河流萎缩所揭示的发现，指出了远远超出该大陆的挑战。

body.en:
In northern Bulgaria, water in the Danube River has fallen so low that scientists say an ancient mammal has once again been exposed to the world.

The remains of what is believed to be a woolly mammoth were uncovered in late July and hailed by historians as a "very important" discovery.

Near the Serbian village of Prahovo, the rusted vessels and broken masts of German warships also resurfaced from the riverbank this month.

"This has literally never happened before; these wrecks ... have never been visible like this. They've always been completely submerged; what we're seeing now is utterly unprecedented," he said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The discoveries along Europe's second-longest river come as parts of central and eastern Europe experience prolonged summer heatwaves and drought conditions.

Armin Fojskic, a member of the Zenica Fishermen Association, said if conditions don't ease, he expects a large number of fish to die in European rivers.

"Low levels of water are critical for the fish, especially if it is extremely low, and these past days it has really been extremely low," Fojskic said.

"The main danger for fish is oxygenation of the river; when water flow drops, the river loses oxygen and fish start to suffocate."

According to the European Drought Observatory, about half of Europe and the United Kingdom experienced drought at various levels of intensity in July. Major wildfires have also burned across the continent .

But Peter Gleick, a hydro-climatologist and co-founder of the Pacific Institute in California, believes what Europe has experienced is not in line with normal weather fluctuations.

"Weather is always variable. We always have droughts. We always have floods somewhere at some time ... but what we're seeing now is extreme events worsened by human-caused climate change," Gleick told SBS News.

"We're dumping greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. We know that's warming the planet. We know that it's altering these extreme events by making them more extreme, more frequent, and more intense."

Gleick said the extreme patterns affecting rivers in Europe are similarly impacting water systems across the globe.

"In the western United States, the Colorado River, which is ... shared by seven [US] states and Mexico, is at record low levels," he said.

"Some of the largest reservoirs in the world are built on the Colorado River, and they're now at record lows."

Nick Bond, the director of freshwater ecosystems at La Trobe University, said the Murray-Darling Basin, Australia's largest river system, has been in decline for decades .

reflection.en: The shrinking rivers in Europe, and their global implications, remind us of our ancient call to care for the earth. Yahweh placed humanity in creation not just to enjoy it, but to actively work and tend to it. This news invites us to reflect on our stewardship and responsibility towards the natural world.
reflection.zh: 欧洲河流的萎缩及其全球影响，提醒我们人类古老的使命，即看顾大地。雅伟将人类安置在受造界中，不仅是为了享受，更是要积极地耕耘和看守。这则新闻邀请我们反思对自然世界的管家职责和责任。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
